roles.name: super_admin
roles.label: 👑 مدير عام
roles.description: Defined in .env via ADMIN_IDS. Has absolute unrestricted access to all commands, router management, user role assignment, reboots, and full system backups.

roles.name: customer
roles.label: 🏢 عميل
roles.description: Customer role assigned via /roles. Shares the admin access level but is scoped to assigned routers through operator_router_permissions.

roles.name: admin
roles.label: 👑 مالك/أدمن
roles.description: Full admin privileges (same level as customer) for owners assigned via /roles.

roles.name: operator
roles.label: 🛠️ مشغّل
roles.description: Operational user assigned via /roles. Restricted to assigned routers (operator_router_permissions) and operational commands (add/edit/cards/reports). Cannot delete routers or perform system reboots.

roles.name: viewer
roles.label: 👁️ مشاهد
roles.description: Read-only access role assigned via /roles. Can view routers, logs, metrics and reports but cannot modify anything.

decorators.name: @admin_only
decorators.purpose: Verifies that the incoming Telegram user ID is present in ADMIN_IDS or admin_roles repository.

decorators.name: @require_role(role_name)
decorators.purpose: Enforces minimum role privilege (ROLE_LEVELS numeric threshold) before executing a handler.

decorators.name: @require_router
decorators.purpose: Ensures the user has an active selected router in user_sessions before proceeding.
